record.title: Continuous generalization of Birch’s theorem beyond prime powers
record.statement:
For all integers $q\ge 2$ and $d\ge 1$, letting $n=q(d+1)-1$, every continuous map $f:\Delta_n\to\mathbb{R}^d$ has points $x_1,\ldots,x_q$ lying in $q$ pairwise disjoint faces of $\Delta_n$ such that
\[
f(x_1)=f(x_2)=\cdots=f(x_q).
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703876), page 16. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The remaining real case of Banach’s isometric conjecture for $n=133$
record.statement: Let $V$ be a real Banach space of dimension $m$, with $1<133<m$, such that all $133$-dimensional subspaces of $V$ are isometric to one another. Must $V$ be a Hilbert space?

record.title: Average complexity of the $(\le k)$-level in a great-circle arrangement
record.statement: Let $C$ be a simple arrangement of great-circles. The expected size of the $(\le k)$-level is at most $16e\,(k+2)^2$ when the south pole is chosen uniformly at random among the cells of $C$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1703876), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Failure of the WLP in six sporadic cases
record.statement:

record.title: Existence of persistence exponents for Gaussian stationary processes
record.statement:
Let $f$ be a Gaussian stationary process over $\mathbb{R}$ with spectral measure $\rho$ having a continuous positive density on $\[-a,a]$ for some $a>0$. For every $\ell\in\mathbb{R}$, the persistence exponent
$$\theta_\rho^\ell:=-\lim_{T\to\infty}\frac{1}{T}\log\mathbb{P}\!\left(\inf_{t\in[0,T]}f_\rho(t)>\ell\right)$$
exists.

record.title: Existence of globalisers for c.e. theories
record.statement: Does every c.e. theory $T$ have a globaliser? Yes. For every c.e. theory $T$, there exists a c.e. theory $U$ such that, for every c.e. theory $S$, $S$ is locally interpretable in $T$ if and only if $S$ is interpretable in $U$; Cheng and Pakhomov state that their theory $R(T)$ has this property.

record.title: Metric realization of the adapted topology of rank $r$

record.title: Metric or semimetric inducing the adapted topology of every rank
record.statement:
For every $r\ge 0$, the map
\[
\mathcal S(V)\times\mathcal S(V)\to[0,\infty),\qquad (X,Y)\mapsto\left\|S_{r+1}\bigl(\operatorname{Law}(\hat X^r)\bigr)-S_{r+1}\bigl(\operatorname{Law}(\hat Y^r)\bigr)\right\|_{\mathcal T_{r+1}}
\]
is a semimetric on $\mathcal S(V)$ that induces the adapted topology of rank $r$, $\tau_r$.

record.title: Hambly–Lyons isometry conjecture for reduced bounded-variation paths
record.statement:
For every reduced bounded-variation path \(\gamma:[0,T]\to\mathbb{R}^d\), the conjectured isometry is
\[
\|\gamma\|_{1\text{-var}}=\limsup_{n\to\infty}\bigl\|n!X^n_{0,T}\bigr\|^{1/n},
\]
where \(X^n_{0,T}\) is the \(n\)-th level of the signature \(S(\gamma)_{0,T}\), and \(\|\cdot\|\) is the projective norm (on the relevant tensor powers induced by the norm on \(\mathbb{R}^d\)).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/40](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/2654836), page 47. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stability of axially symmetric stationary steady states
record.statement: Axially symmetric stationary steady states have been studied numerically, see for instance [27, 1], and constructed [24], but the problem of their stability remains largely open.

record.title: Vu’s conjecture on nonsingularity of random regular adjacency matrices
record.statement: Let $R_n$ be the adjacency matrix of a uniformly random $d$-regular directed graph on $n$ vertices, equivalently a uniformly random $n\times n$ $0/1$ matrix having exactly $d$ ones in every row and every column. Vu’s conjecture asserts that, for every sequence $d=d_n$ satisfying $3\le d_n\le n-3$, $\mathbb{P}\{R_n\text{ is singular}\}\to 0$ as $n\to\infty$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/6](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17469), page 17. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Novak’s positive-semidefiniteness conjecture for a trigonometric matrix
record.statement:
For all integers $n,d\ge 2$ and all choices of $x_1,\ldots,x_n\in\mathbb{R}^d$, the matrix
\[
\left\{\prod_{i=1}^{d}\frac{1+\cos(x_{j,i}-x_{k,i})}{2}-\frac{1}{n}\right\}_{j,k=1}^{n}
\]
is positive semidefinite.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/6](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17469), page 29. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.statement: Conjecture: Theorem 4 should also hold for closed, connected, smooth manifolds of dimension at least 5 with odd-order abelian fundamental group that are spin, p-atoral for every prime p dividing the order of the fundamental group, and have vanishing \b1-invariants; namely, such a manifold admits a Riemannian metric of positive scalar curvature.

record.title: Virtual algebraic fibring and vanishing of higher $L^2$-Betti numbers
record.statement: Let $G$ be a RFRS group of type $\mathrm{FP}_n(\mathbb{Q})$. Then $G$ admits a finite-index subgroup $H$ and an epimorphism $\phi:H\to\mathbb{Z}$ with kernel of type $\mathrm{FP}_n(\mathbb{Q})$ if and only if $\beta_i^{(2)}(G)=0$ for every $i\le n$.

record.title: Characterization of normal Sylow subgroups by constituents of a permutation character
record.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group, let $p$ be a prime, and let $P\in\operatorname{Syl}_p(G)$. Then $P\trianglelefteq G$ if and only if $p\nmid\chi(1)$ for every irreducible constituent $\chi\in\operatorname{Irr}((1_P)^G)$ of the induced permutation character $(1_P)^G$.

record.title: Saxl’s conjecture
record.statement:
Let $\rho=(k,k-1,k-2,\ldots,2,1)\vdash n$ be a staircase partition. Then
\[
D_{\mathbb C}(\rho)\otimes D_{\mathbb C}(\rho)=\bigoplus_{\lambda\vdash n} g(\rho,\rho,\lambda)D_{\mathbb C}(\lambda),
\]
with multiplicity $g(\rho,\rho,\lambda)\ne 0$ for all partitions $\lambda$ of $n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2020/9](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/17472), page 25. Canonicalized from 7 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The WNU tractability conjecture for constraint satisfaction problems
record.statement: In 2007 it was conjectured that the Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP) over a constraint language $\Gamma$ is tractable if and only if $\Gamma$ is preserved by a weak near-unanimity (WNU) operation. After many efforts and partial results, this conjecture was independently proved by Andrei Bulatov and Dmitriy Zhuk in 2017.

record.statement: Theorem 1. Suppose that, for each vortex component, the initial vorticity satisfies $W_{2}\!\left(\frac{\omega_i^0}{\lambda_i},\delta_{X_i^0}\right)\lesssim\varepsilon$ and $\|\omega_i^0\|_{L^p}\lesssim\varepsilon^{-\gamma}$, with $\gamma=2\left(1-\frac{2}{p}\right)$. Then estimate (5) holds for every $t\in(0,T)$ for some $T\gtrsim1$.

It states that this question was solved for $N=3$ by Sundman and for $N\ge 3$ by Qiu-Dong Wang: each solution admits a series expansion convergent for all $t$ in its maximal interval of existence.

record.title: Local–global principle for projective homogeneous spaces over function fields

\]

G(k)/R \cong G(A)/R \cong G(K)/R.

record.title: Local typicality of the Newhouse phenomenon
record.statement: Is the Newhouse phenomenon locally typical? record.title: Uniform spectral bound for exact Lagrangians in the unit cotangent disc bundle of a homogeneous space
record.statement:
Let $N$ be a homogeneous space, and let $D T^*N$ be the unit disc bundle of $T^*N$. Then there exists a constant $C$ such that, for every exact Lagrangian $L$ in $D T^*N$, one has
$$
\gamma(L)\le C.
$$

record.title: Inverse Galois Problem over \(\mathbb{Q}\)

X(\mathcal{O}_K)=X(\mathbb{Z})
\]
for 100% of primitive number fields $K$ of degree $n$, when ordered by discriminant.

record.title: Completeness of the list of exceptional \-adic Galois images

record.title: Infinitely many simple abelian varieties over \(\mathbb F_2\) of every prescribed positive order
record.statement: For every positive integer \(m\), there exist infinitely many simple abelian varieties over \(\mathbb F_2\), of various dimensions, whose groups of \(\mathbb F_2\)-rational points have order \(m\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2021/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/8415337), page 38. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
